title: Mediterranean Blue Triple Glass Shelf, 16 X 5 In, Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Triple glass shelf with 16 x 5 inch glass dimensions, wall mount installation, and solid brass hardware for bathroom storage and display in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Three-tier wall-mounted glass shelf keeps toiletries organized while saving space. Traditional style with thick 0.38 in beveled-edge glass and concealed screw mounting for a clean look. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4 in screws. Weight capacity 6 lb. Ideal for classic bath accessories, heritage bathroom fixtures, and traditional bathroom hardware. Match with coordinating pieces from the Carolina collection for a unified look. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Carolina.
